title: ARC: A Self-Tuning, Low Overhead Replacement Cache
evidence_note: Balances recent and repeated page use with metadata for evicted pages; evaluates cache behavior under varied traces.
limitation: Uniform-page cache experiments do not measure document authority, complete supporting evidence or agent task accuracy.
review_level: Selected full-text problem definition, ghost-cache discussion, replacement mechanism and evaluation setup.

title: TinyLFU: A Highly Efficient Cache Admission Policy
venue_or_status: arXiv v2, December 3, 2015; reviewed version, without inferring later publication status
evidence_note: Separates admission from replacement using recent approximate frequency; reset aging and a recency window handle changing demand.
limitation: Cache hit-ratio evaluations do not establish retention of rare constraints or downstream factual sufficiency.
review_level: Selected full-text introduction, freshness/reset mechanism, doorkeeper, W-TinyLFU design and trace setup.

title: SIEVE is Simpler than LRU: an Efficient Turn-Key Eviction Algorithm for Web Caches
evidence_note: Uses a queue, visited bit and moving hand; evaluates efficiency and scalability on web/object-cache traces and implementations.
limitation: Object reuse and throughput do not measure agent evidence completeness; access patterns and capacities bound transfer.
review_level: Selected full-text algorithm, lazy-promotion/quick-demotion explanation, implementation and workload sections.

title: When Fancy Eviction Fails: Rethinking Cache Replacement For LLM Prefix Reuse
venue_or_status: arXiv v1, September 24, 2026; recent unreplicated preprint
evidence_note: Studies prefix-cache eviction with production traces and a serving-aware simulator; proposes compute-aware evaluation beyond ordinary hit ratio.
limitation: KV-prefix computation reuse is distinct from selecting semantic evidence; trace and simulator findings do not establish a filesystem-memory winner.
review_level: Selected full-text introduction, workload/design implications and prefix-cache background.

title: Apache Kafka 4.1 Design: Log Compaction
venue_or_status: Versioned Kafka 4.1 design documentation; page last modified December 19, 2025; older version intentionally identified
evidence_note: Specifies last-value-per-key retention, stable offsets, background compaction and conditions under which consumers observe deletion markers.
limitation: Keyed mutable-state semantics do not preserve every historical explanation; this is documentation, not an agent experiment.
review_level: Full log-compaction section including basics, guarantees, deletion-marker retention and configuration.
reviewed_sections: What guarantees does log compaction provide?

title: Apache Cassandra: Compaction Overview
venue_or_status: Live stable documentation accessed in 2026; year denotes access, not an established publication date
evidence_note: Explains tombstones, purge conditions and how missing deletion information can allow old replica data to reappear.
limitation: Distributed database rules and grace intervals are system-specific; no interval or accuracy benefit transfers automatically to agent files.
review_level: Selected documentation sections on deletion, tombstones, grace periods and fully expired SSTables.

title: RocksDB deletion semantics: DeleteRange and Compaction Filter
venue_or_status: DeleteRange engineering post, November 21, 2018; related official Compaction Filter wiki last edited January 26, 2022
evidence_note: Separates deletion visibility from compaction/reclamation; the related wiki documents skipped-key resurrection and snapshot-repeatability exceptions.
limitation: Two related official documents grouped in one record; historical implementation statements are not a current deployment test or agent-memory benchmark.
review_level: Selected DeleteRange motivation, write/read paths, snapshot/compaction discussion; Compaction Filter core behavior and caveats.

title: Git: git-gc Documentation
venue_or_status: Live official manual accessed in 2026; year denotes access, not an established publication date
evidence_note: Documents object retention through references, the index and reflogs, and limitations of protection during concurrent object creation.
limitation: Syntactic reachability differs from semantic value; incomplete dependency roots can make useful evidence appear dead.
review_level: Selected description, pruning options and NOTES sections; no command executed against the project or vault.

title: MemoryBank: Enhancing Large Language Models with Long-Term Memory
venue_or_status: First preprint 2023; AAAI 2024; arXiv v3 reviewed
evidence_note: Adds a time-and-recall-dependent memory-strength mechanism alongside conversations, event summaries and user portraits.
limitation: Companion and generated-dialogue evaluation does not establish a universal forgetting rate or sustained project-continuation performance.
review_level: Selected full-text storage, retrieval, forgetting/update mechanism and quantitative evaluation setup.
cross_catalog_note: Revisits AM02; not an additional unique study.

title: Evaluating Memory in LLM Agents via Incremental Multi-Turn Interactions
venue_or_status: MemoryAgentBench; author repository identifies ICLR 2026 acceptance; arXiv v4, June 28, 2026 reviewed
evidence_note: Feeds reconstructed contexts incrementally and includes ordered counterfactual edits with current-state questions.
limitation: Constructed edits and supplied overwrite rules simplify authority; temporal consistency is not the same as physical deletion or open-ended project continuity.
review_level: Selected v4 full-text benchmark formulation, dataset preparation and selective-forgetting design; earlier v2 description also inspected.
cross_catalog_note: Revisits RE01 with a newer inspected version; not an additional unique study.

title: From Recall to Forgetting: Benchmarking Long-Term Memory for Personalized Agents
evidence_note: Generates conversations from evolving state traces and evaluates valid-memory presence and invalid-memory absence over simulated durations.
limitation: Generated personas/dialogue and judge-based criteria bound validity; simulated calendar duration is not observed deployment time.
review_level: Selected full-text session simulation, conversation generation, evaluation criteria, FAMA definition and experiment settings.

title: Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs
venue_or_status: arXiv v1, May 13, 2026; unreplicated in this review
evidence_note: Compares update schedules and episodic/abstract stores; reports deterioration under repeated textual consolidation in tested tasks.
limitation: Contemporary tested models/tasks and consolidation loops bound transfer; does not establish that every abstraction is harmful or raw retention is optimal.
review_level: Selected full-text experiment setup, stream consolidation, ARC-AGI Stream controls, interference and limitations.
reviewed_sections: 4 Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs

title: Deployment-Time Memorization in Foundation-Model Agents
evidence_note: Tests retention/extraction tradeoffs and deletion modes on synthetic canaries in 50 sampled LongMemEval-oracle instances.
limitation: Bounded canary attacks, sampled histories and proxy utility do not certify universal erasure or naturalistic task accuracy.
review_level: Selected full-text pipeline, deletion ladder, forgetting-residue definition and experimental setup/results.

title: FSFM: A Biologically-Inspired Framework for Selective Forgetting of Agent Memory
venue_or_status: arXiv v1, April 22, 2026; framework claims require independent validation
evidence_note: Provides a forgetting taxonomy and capacity-triggered priority policy with a reported capped-versus-unlimited comparison.
limitation: Resource conditions differ; reported important-record loss and labeled-content elimination do not establish universal fidelity or security.
review_level: Selected full-text taxonomy and methods, capacity constraints, scoring/tuning protocol and Tables 2-3.

title: Learning What to Remember: A Cognitively Grounded Multi-Factor Value Model for Agentic Memory
evidence_note: Separates oracle future-query scoring from blind retention and fits weights to a budgeted gold-retention objective.
limitation: Downstream QA is untested, only four of seven factors are active, and one benchmark/annotation scheme limits transfer.
review_level: Selected full-text factor design, weight learning, oracle/blind protocol, held-out evaluation description and explicit limitations.

title: It's Not That Important: Demoting Personal Information of Low Subjective Importance Using GrayArea
evidence_note: Evaluates an interface that demotes files within their folder instead of requiring deletion.
limitation: Primary abstract only; folder-cleaning study does not measure agent accuracy or extended reactivation.
review_level: Primary abstract and publication metadata only; full paper not reviewed in this round.
cross_catalog_note: Revisits OR06; not an additional unique study.

title: Reflections of the Environment in Memory
evidence_note: Relates future need in examined environments to recency, frequency and exposure patterns as an account of human memory.
limitation: Abstract-level review cannot validate detailed controls; human/environmental relationships do not prescribe a filesystem TTL.
review_level: Publisher primary abstract and metadata only; attempted academic-hosted PDF access failed.
